reason: ESPN does not report the figure itself: it says the nearly $100 million 'has been widely reported in the British media' and that Hearn did not dispute it, naming no outlet. The $40 million has a named origin (Mike Coppinger, The Athletic) and is repeated by three sites, but those three all trace to him, so this is one reporter against an unattributed rumour, not three sources against one; treat the $40 million as the best-supported figure, not a confirmed one.

Pre-fight report of a revised deal ('about $10 million', Coppinger). ESPN's contract figure and a post-fight summary both say $9 million, so the total is recorded at $9 million; the $10 million guarantee stays in the data as its own single-source figure (Gulf News). The real amount lies between $9 million and $10 million and this decision is the least certain one in the set.

Dan Rafael's first report says 'at least 650,000' (OutKick repeats it as 'around 650,000', crediting him, so it is the same report, not a second source). A floor is compatible with the roughly 700,000 that Front Office Sports and Wikipedia give, so it is not a disagreement with them.

The $55 million is the 650,000 floor multiplied by the $84.99 price, which the page itself says ('generated a gross of more than $55 million'), not a figure anyone published separately; it moves with the buys figure it was computed from.

The Sportster's own text says 'close to $38 million' and the page itself notes other outlets give $45 million; Wikipedia and MMA Mania, which are independent of each other, both give $45 million for Usyk's first-fight purse.

A 2013 passing comparison ('sold for $50') against HBO's own suggested retail price of $54.95 reported before the fight by Multichannel News, which Wikipedia rounds to $55. Fox's figure is a round number from memory of a six-year-old fight; the contemporaneous price is the better evidence.

'Over the 800,000 mark' is a preliminary industry estimate, a lower bound given before HBO's numbers came in; ESPN's roughly 830,000 and Wikipedia's roughly 850,000 are consistent with it and with each other.
A 2023 retrospective gives Hagler a $13 million guarantee; Wikipedia and F4W Online (independent of each other) both say $12 million. Only the WBA piece, one source, says $13 million.
